clue.text: Horseback 1914 dandies seen in many a fall

parts.note: a cob is a stocky short-legged horse kept for riding, the kind of mount you sit on horseback
nuts was slang around the First World War for fashionable young men about town, dandies

explanation.surface: Pre-war dandies on horseback taking a tumble in the hunting field.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fall' is the American word for autumn, when these hazelnuts drop from the tree; the surface has the dandies falling off their horses.
explanation.definitionFit: Cultivated hazelnuts ripen and drop in autumn, the season Americans call fall.

clue.text: Handy cause of a partial eclipse of the half-moon

definitions.text: Handy cause of a partial eclipse of the half-moon

parts.words: Handy cause of a partial eclipse of the half-moon
parts.note: the half-moon is the pale crescent at the base of a fingernail, which a fold of skin on the hand partly covers

explanation.definitionFit: The thin skin at the base of a fingernail can grow over the pale lunula there.

clue.text: Liberal lady

definitions.meaning: Lady ..., the charitable gentlewoman in Farquhar's play The Beaux' Stratagem

explanation.definitionFit: Generous in giving, and the second half of Lady Bountiful, the byword for a charitable woman.

clue.text: Said to Eros, but not by a Venus

definitions.text: Said to Eros, but not by a Venus

parts.words: Said to Eros, but not by a Venus
parts.note: Antony tells his servant Eros to take off his armour in Antony and Cleopatra, an order no armless Venus de Milo could give

explanation.definitionFit: To strip someone of armour, as Antony orders: Unarm, Eros; the long day's task is done.

clue.text: unlike 10, a flight of risers

parts.note: risers are the upright parts of steps, so a flight of them stays put, unlike the flying machine at 10

explanation.definitionFit: A set of steps is a flight made up of risers and treads.

clue.text: Dad retiring conceals himself from Rosa's hangers-on

indicators.note: retiring means drawing back, so the word for Dad is read backwards

parts.note: pa is a familiar word for a father
to hide is to conceal oneself

explanation.surface: A shy father slips away and hides from the people clinging to someone called Rosa.
explanation.walkthrough: Rosa is the Latin name of the rose genus, not a woman: its hangers-on are the greenfly that cling to the stems.
explanation.definitionFit: Greenfly, plural of aphis, are sap-sucking insects that cluster on roses.

clue.text: Right stage for kitchen-sink drama ?

parts.note: names a stage that juts into the audience, and the garment worn while washing up at the sink

explanation.definitionFit: Both the part of a stage projecting past the curtain and the cloth tied on for kitchen work.

clue.text: Promoter of sweet sleep and bitter dreams ?

definitions.text: Promoter of sweet sleep and bitter dreams ?

parts.words: Promoter of sweet sleep and bitter dreams ?
parts.note: a cushion stuffed with the bitter flowers used in brewing beer, long thought to bring sleep

explanation.definitionFit: A cushion filled with dried hop cones, a folk remedy for sleeplessness; hops give beer its bitterness.

clue.text: Fire-breathing Greek statesman

definitions.meaning: the Latin word for a dragon, the fire-breathing monster, also the constellation
the Athenian lawgiver whose harsh code gave us draconian

explanation.definitionFit: Latin for dragon and the name of the Athenian lawmaker famous for severe laws.

clue.text: The affair of the lady with a fringe

parts.note: she is the pronoun for a lady
bangs is the American word for a fringe of hair cut straight across the forehead

explanation.surface: Gossip about a woman with a fringe haircut and her affair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The affair' is the thing as a whole, as in the whole shebang.
explanation.definitionFit: Shebang means the business or matter in hand, as in the whole shebang.

clue.text: Tree smashed a hut, yes if you look back

indicators.note: smashed means broken up, so the letters of the hut are rearranged
looking back means reading the word for yes from right to left

parts.note: ay is an old word for yes

explanation.surface: A tree has fallen and wrecked a hut, as you will see if you turn round.
explanation.definitionFit: Thuya is a genus of coniferous trees, the arbor vitae, also spelt thuja.

clue.text: Unlike 4, riser of flights

parts.note: a flight of stairs is made of risers; here the thing itself rises and makes flights through the air, the reverse of the staircase at 4

explanation.definitionFit: A powered aircraft takes off, climbing into the sky on each flight it makes.

clue.text: Hull's beside itself !

parts.note: reads as the Yorkshire city in a frenzy, but describes a boat whose hull sits beside a twin hull

explanation.definitionFit: A twin-hulled sailing boat has two parallel hulls, each lying beside the other.

clue.text: Wrong notions of how to develop a lido

indicators.note: developing the letters means working them into a new form, so a lido is rearranged

explanation.surface: Mistaken ideas about how a public swimming pool should be built.
explanation.walkthrough: A lido is an outdoor public swimming pool, a British usage.
explanation.definitionFit: Bacon's idola (plural of idolum) are the false notions or fallacies that mislead the mind.

clue.text: Gray espoused two famous Johns

parts.note: Euphemia Gray married the critic John Ruskin and, after an annulment, the painter John Everett Millais

explanation.definitionFit: Euphemia Gray, known by her pet name, was wife first of John Ruskin and then of John Everett Millais.

clue.text: To annihilate one French town causes jeopardy

parts.note: to end something is to finish it off, destroy it
Angers is a town on the Loire in western France

explanation.surface: Destroying a French town puts everything at risk.
explanation.definitionFit: To imperil something is to put it at risk, in jeopardy.

clue.text: Jack, pencil poised over this? Is quitting

parts.note: a jack tar is a sailor, and AB, able seaman, is the usual sailor abbreviation
the reader with pencil poised over the crossword is in the act of working it out

explanation.surface: A man named Jack sits with pencil poised over the puzzle, then gives up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Quit' in the old sense means to acquit or release from blame, so 'quitting' fits the definition; 'Is' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To absolve is to set free from guilt, the archaic sense of quit as acquit.

clue.text: City to enquire at and no delay about it

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word for no delay goes round the rest

parts.note: soon means without delay
to ask is to enquire
taken as written

explanation.surface: Ask at the city information desk, and without delay.
explanation.definitionFit: Saskatoon is the largest city in the Canadian province of Saskatchewan.

clue.text: Ladies, whose bright eyes Rain (Milton)

parts.note: the missing word completes a line of Milton's poem L'Allegro about ladies at court and tournaments

explanation.definitionFit: Milton's L'Allegro: ladies whose bright eyes rain influence, the astrological power once thought to stream from stars.

clue.text: In' which Cinderella would not have welcomed ragtime

definitions.text: In' which Cinderella would not have welcomed ragtime

parts.words: In' which Cinderella would not have welcomed ragtime
parts.note: ragtime here is the time for rags, which Cinderella feared when midnight struck at the ball, not the music

explanation.definitionFit: Cinderella wore a gown for the ball that turned back into rags at midnight.

clue.text: Cooks sea-bream ?

definitions.meaning: stews slowly in a covered pot
braise is an old local name for the sea bream fish

explanation.definitionFit: The word means stews slowly in a closed pot, and braise is a dialect name for the sea bream.

clue.text: Thin seal on ice

definitions.meaning: a thin disc of dried paste once used to seal letters
the crisp thin biscuit served with an ice cream

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a thin adhesive disc for sealing letters and the crisp biscuit set on an ice cream.

clue.text: Repeat, " Pray take a seat "

parts.note: reads as a host's polite invitation, but the seat is in Parliament and voters return the member to it again

explanation.definitionFit: Voters return a sitting member to office for another term, giving them the seat again.

clue.text: And what said Emmet about Chekhov?

parts.note: emmet is an old dialect word for an ant, so in plain words Emmet says ant
on means concerning, about

explanation.surface: Someone asks what a man named Emmet had to say about Chekhov.
explanation.walkthrough: Emmet looks like a person's name but is the dialect word for an ant.
explanation.definitionFit: Chekhov's first name was Anton, the Russian playwright and story writer.

clue.text: Leonora his love? But he gets to embracing Titania's

indicators.note: embracing means holding inside, so the word to wraps round Titania's love

parts.note: taken as written
in A Midsummer Night's Dream the fairy queen Titania dotes on Bottom wearing an ass's head, so her love is an ass

explanation.surface: A man loves Leonora, but is reduced to hugging the fairy queen's favourite.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Titania's' stands for Titania's love, borrowing 'love' from the first half.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian poet Torquato Tasso is said to have loved Leonora d'Este at the Ferrara court.

clue.text: What happiness to make a meal of it in a Cornish resort

indicators.note: in tells us one piece sits inside the resort's name

parts.note: Bude is a seaside resort in Cornwall, in south-west England
to make a meal of something is literally to eat it

explanation.surface: Bliss is eating a hearty holiday meal at a seaside town in Cornwall.
explanation.definitionFit: Beatitude is supreme blessedness, a state of perfect joy.

clue.text: The regimental colours

parts.note: reads as a regiment's flags, but means the nickname of a cavalry regiment and the shade it is named for

explanation.definitionFit: The Royal Horse Guards are known by this nickname, from their dark coats; it is also the plural of a colour.

clue.text: Bring on oneself the description of a dog's dinner ?

parts.note: once eaten, a dinner is inside the animal
a cur is a mongrel dog

explanation.surface: A messy meal for a mongrel, something you might have only yourself to blame for.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'dog's dinner' is British slang for a mess, but here the dinner is literally in the cur.
explanation.definitionFit: To incur a cost or penalty is to bring it upon yourself.

clue.text: Held on, so's to comprehend a strange tune

indicators.note: to comprehend is to take in, so the phrase so's to holds the other letters inside it

parts.note: taken as written, ignoring the apostrophe

indicators.note: strange means odd or altered, so the letters of tune are rearranged

explanation.surface: A musician holds a note so as to understand an unfamiliar melody.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Held on' reads as a past participle but is the musical direction; 'comprehend' puts the rearranged letters of tune (from 'strange') inside so's to.
explanation.definitionFit: Sostenuto is the musical direction for notes that are sustained, kept sounding.

clue.text: Leave to go to steady a conger-eel?

annotationWithheld.why: Leave to go to steady a conger-eel? (5): 'Leave to go' defines CONGE, but no reading found makes 'to steady a conger-eel' give the word, so the second half's job is unexplained
annotationWithheld.clue: Leave to go to steady a conger-eel?

clue.text: They're some good joiner's work

parts.note: a joiner sounds like a carpenter, but here is the priest who joins couples in marriage

explanation.definitionFit: Husbands and wives are the people a minister joins together at a wedding.

clue.text: And neither do we take a street going this way

parts.note: nor means and neither
taken as written
St is the usual abbreviation for street

explanation.surface: Nor shall we take that street; we are heading in this direction.
explanation.definitionFit: The compass direction midway between north and west, the way a road heads.
